# Aung Myint Oo - AI Product Architect & Founding Engineer

> Aung Myint Oo (AMO) is an AI product architect and founding engineer based in Singapore. He takes AI products from idea to production end to end (architecture, AI and agentic systems, infrastructure, launch, and operations) and partners with founders and domain experts to turn industry expertise into working AI products. The first conversation is always free.

## Who he is

- Founding Engineer & Technical Lead at Salesbugle (https://salesbugle.com), an AI sales coaching SaaS he built from empty repository to production with paying customers, as the sole engineer. Product releases ship continuously at https://app.salesbugle.com/whats-new.
- Builder of amoOS, a personal software factory: an AI operating system where a fleet of AI coding agents does the building while he plans, dispatches, and verifies. It orchestrates 11 projects, compiles 400+ knowledge pages, and reports through a native macOS app and Telegram.
- Previously robotics and computer vision engineer at Mozark, with robotic mobile-testing systems deployed across Singapore, Philippines, Thailand, and India.
- MSc Robotics (National University of Singapore), B.Eng Electrical Engineering (Honours).

## What he solves

- "I have an idea but no way to build it": fixed-scope builds from first conversation to production.
- "A workflow or process that needs a modern solution": focused engagements applying AI and automation to one problem.
- "I know my industry but have no technical partner": long-term, equity-aligned technical partnership for domain experts.

## Expertise

AI agent fleets and multi-agent orchestration, hosted remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers (86 tools in production, usable by Claude, Codex, Manus, or any MCP client), real-time meeting AI (bots that join live video calls, present, listen, and answer by name), agentic chat with governed writes and audit trails, LLM pipelines, RAG systems, vector search, FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, Cloudflare, CI/CD, production operations, computer vision, robotics.
